meta.note: Round-2 gap-closing pass for the China monetary & liquidity dataset. Companion to series.json - DOES NOT REPLACE IT. Same hard environment constraint as round 1: the egress proxy 403s every macro-data publisher (FRED, NBS, PBoC, ChinaBond, CFETS, BIS, IMF, World Bank, EastMoney) and also blocks the GitHub REST/search API, github.com HTML and codeload. The one channel that DOES work is 'git clone' over the git proxy, plus raw.githubusercontent.com and PyPI; WebSearch was used only to LOCATE candidate repositories. Every value in this file was read out of a repository actually cloned in this session - nothing is estimated, interpolated, or recalled from memory. All confidences are 'partial' because every source is a third-party mirror, never a publisher's own domain. INTEGRITY INCIDENT WORTH READING: the first promising DR007 source (a macro dashboard repo) turned out to ship synthetic 'demo' data for 2024-2025 alongside genuine data for 2026; it was caught by diffing against the Wind DR007.IB daily history (221 of 230 days wrong, up to 58bp) and the fabricated block was discarded rather than shipped. Any future pass should apply the same test before trusting a dashboard mirror.
gaps: dr007: ONLY PARTIALLY closed. Genuine data recovered for 2026-06..2026-09 (2026-09 partial, to the 11th). The 2025-01..2026-05 hole REMAINS OPEN and is still the single most valuable missing piece. Searched/cloned 12 repositories (Hosen760/Asset-allocation, yuwxsarah/macroscope-dashboard, littlepeachh/macroscope-dashboard-v5/v7/v52, tonybzzhao/china-macro, xuanlinliu85-ai/macro-high-frequency-monitor, hanlulong/openecon-data, lightfor/lightfor.github.io, harvey1673/pyktrader2, Zhyblx/shclearing, unbalancedparentheses/forex-centuries). The Wind mirror is comprehensive but stops 2024-12-12; the AKShare-backed dashboard only keeps a ~100-day rolling window and its repo history starts 2026-08-03, so unshallowing the git history yielded nothing earlier. No mirror covering calendar 2025 was found.
r007 (all-market 7-day pledged repo) / fr007: NOT FOUND. No repository located that mirrors R007 or FR007 at any frequency. The Wind export family that carries DR007 has no R007 file.

ncd_1y_aaa (1-year AAA negotiable CD, 同业存单): NOT FOUND. Four searches plus inspection of the ChinaBond curve repo (which carries gov, CDB, EXIM, ADBC, local-gov, railway and corporate AAA/AA/A curves) found no 同业存单 curve. harvey1673/pyktrader2 references 同业存单:发行利率 3M/6M only as Wind field names, with no data committed.

cfets (CFETS RMB trade-weighted index): NOT FOUND. No GitHub mirror located. The BIS broad REER now supplied in this file is the closest available trade-weighted substitute but is a DIFFERENT index (different basket, CPI-deflated, 2020=100) - do not treat them as interchangeable.

shibor_3m: NOT FOUND as a clean series. A SHIBOR overnight column does exist in the macroscope liquidity file (2006-10..2026-09) but it is contaminated by the same synthetic demo block across 2024-2025, and it is the overnight tenor, not 3-month, so it was deliberately NOT emitted.
cnh_hibor_on: NOT FOUND. No offshore CNH HIBOR mirror located on any reachable host.

fiscal_deposits, govt_bond_issuance, tsf_ex_govt_yoy, corp_mlt_loans_yoy: NOT FOUND. These are PBoC/MoF sub-components that no reachable mirror breaks out; the mirrors found carry only headline TSF, M1/M2 and new RMB loans, all of which series.json already has.
reer ends 2026-01: the BIS flat file vendored in forex-centuries is a snapshot, so roughly the last seven months of BIS REER are unavailable here.

omo_7d / mlf_1y are supplied as FETCHED step series but both END in late 2024 (2024-12-24 and 2024-11-25). They corroborate but do not supersede analyst_supplied.json for 2025-2026; the May-2025 cut to 1.40% is attested only in PBoC Monetary Policy Report prose, without an exact date.

ENVIRONMENT: GitHub's REST API, code search, repo search, github.com HTML and codeload are ALL blocked by the proxy in this session (403). Repository discovery therefore depended entirely on WebSearch, and file retrieval entirely on 'git clone' + raw.githubusercontent.com. gitlab.com appears reachable but was not needed; codeberg.org, gitee.com, huggingface.co and datahub.io are all blocked.

dr007.name: DR007, depository-institution 7-day pledged repo rate
dr007.name_zh: 银行间存款类机构7天期质押式回购利率
dr007.notes: CONVENTION: monthly AVERAGE of daily fixings. PARTIAL EXTENSION ONLY - covers 2026-06..2026-09; 2026-09 is a partial month (11 days, to 2026-09-11) and 2026-06 is a full month. This does NOT close the 2025-01..2026-05 hole in series.json's dr007. IMPORTANT INTEGRITY NOTE: the same source file contains a 2024-01-02..2025-12-29 block that is SYNTHETIC placeholder data (the repo ships 'built-in demo data, auto-replaced after the first online update'); it was tested against the Wind DR007.IB daily history and disagreed on 221 of 230 overlapping days by up to 58bp, so it was DISCARDED and only the genuine 中国货币网/AKShare window (4-decimal fixings, 2026-06-01 onward) is used here. Sanity: these averages sit 0-3bp either side of the 1.40% 7-day OMO policy rate, consistent with the PBoC 2025Q2 Monetary Policy Report statement that DR007 averaged 1.58% right after the May-2025 cut and has since drifted to the policy rate.

provenance.source_name: yuwxsarah/macroscope-dashboard (upstream: 中国货币网 / CFETS via AKShare)

cgb_1y.name: China government bond yield, 1-year
cgb_1y.name_zh: 中债国债到期收益率:1年
cgb_1y.notes: CONVENTION: monthly AVERAGE of the daily ChinaBond (中债) government-bond yield-to-maturity curve. Source file is the full 1Y-50Y term structure (ycDefId 2c9081e50a2f9606010a3068cae70001), auto-updated daily by GitHub Actions. First month (2016-05) and last month (2026-09, to the 11th) are PARTIAL-month averages. CROSS-CHECK: validated against the Wind 中证指数公司 1-year CGB curve (a DIFFERENT compiler, so exact agreement is not expected) - mean abs diff 1.8bp over 2093 overlapping days, 81% within 3bp. The 10Y leg of this same file matches two independent ChinaBond mirrors exactly, which corroborates the file as a whole.

provenance.source_name: jy-zhang-sig/bond-yield-curve (upstream: 中债金融估值中心 / ChinaBond yield curve)

reer.name: Real broad effective exchange rate, China (BIS)
reer.name_zh: 人民币实际有效汇率指数(BIS广义)
reer.notes: BIS broad real effective exchange rate, 64-economy basket, CPI-deflated, index 2020=100. A RISE is an appreciation of the RMB in real trade-weighted terms. Extracted from the official BIS WS_EER flat CSV (dataflow BIS:WS_EER(1.0), series 'China - Real - Broad (64 economies)') as vendored in the forex-centuries data collection. Ends 2026-01 - BIS publishes with a lag and this mirror's snapshot is from early 2026, so the last ~7 months are NOT available here. Shape check: peak 105.76 at 2021-12, 97.43 at 2022-12, 92.14 at 2023-12, 91.55 at 2024-12, trough 86.23 at 2025-06, recovering to 89.85 by 2026-01.

provenance.source_name: unbalancedparentheses/forex-centuries (upstream: BIS effective exchange rate statistics, dataflow WS_EER)

usdcny.name: USD/CNY exchange rate, monthly average
usdcny.notes: FRED series DEXCHUS (Chinese Yuan Renminbi to U.S. Dollar Spot Exchange Rate), monthly frequency as published by FRED (monthly average of daily noon buying rates). A RISE is a DEPRECIATION of the RMB. Pre-1994 values reflect the old dual/official-rate regime and are not comparable with the post-1994 unified rate. CROSS-CHECK: agrees with an independent daily USD/CNY mirror (tonybzzhao/china-macro, 6844 daily obs to 2026-09-11) aggregated to monthly means - mean abs diff 0.0016, max 0.0106 across 319 overlapping months; also consistent with a second DEXCHUS copy in forex-centuries through 2025-12. NOTE: series.json's gaps mention a single spot quote of 6.7811 on 2026-08-28 from a dashboard; DEXCHUS puts the 2026-08 monthly average at 6.7361, so that spot figure should not be treated as a monthly value.

provenance.source_name: datasets/exchange-rates (upstream: US Federal Reserve H.10 via FRED, series DEXCHUS)

omo_7d.name: 7-day reverse repo operation rate (policy rate)
omo_7d.notes: STEP SERIES: only the dates on which the rate CHANGED are recorded (first date at each new level), derived from a daily Wind export by dropping repeated values; forward-fill onto your monthly grid. Independent FETCHED corroboration for the analyst-supplied omo_7d in analyst_supplied.json, which had to be written from domain knowledge. Confirms 1.50% from 2024-09-29 through the file's end (2024-12-24) and reproduces the full cut sequence before that. ENDS 2024-12 - the 1.50%->1.40% cut of May 2025 is NOT in this file; the PBoC 2025Q2 Monetary Policy Report (fetched separately this session) states verbatim that the 7-day reverse repo operation rate was lowered from 1.5% to 1.4%, which dates that cut to Q2 2025 but gives no exact day.

provenance.source_name: Hosen760/Asset-allocation (upstream: Wind export of the PBoC operation rate, file is GBK-encoded)

mlf_1y.name: 1-year MLF rate
mlf_1y.notes: STEP SERIES: only the dates on which the rate CHANGED are recorded (first date at each new level), derived from a daily Wind export by dropping repeated values; forward-fill onto your monthly grid. Closes the 'mlf_1y OMITTED' gap in series.json for the period covered. ENDS 2024-11-25 at 2.00%. Note the PBoC de-emphasised MLF as a policy rate during 2024 and from 2025 switched MLF to multi-price tenders, so post-2024 'the MLF rate' is no longer a single published policy rate - do not forward-fill this beyond 2024 as if it were one.
